title: 第011章 颜值就是正义第012章 这题库绝对更新了
lines: 参加灵木系大一唯一一个名额战的学霸们，都是精锐。
王会综合评价：理论知识1级09分，实践能力1级07，这位就算现在就大学毕业进入社会，放在全国范围也是优秀本科毕业生水准。
于飞煌综合评价：理论知识0级99，实践能力0级98。
李亚琳综合评价：理论知识0级96，实践能力0级97。
苏恒自己综合评价：理论知识1级45，实践能力1级19。
他小惊讶的发现，除了王会和一周前的数据毫无变化外，不管心高气傲的于飞煌，还是大一小女神李亚琳，都比一周前评分更高了，不过也正常，他在努力学习还时不时完成一次学神系统发布的任务，其他学霸们也不会闲着干等。
抛开这常年前三的学霸。
全系近一年来各种考核占据前五的另外两人。
郭耀光综合评价：理论知识0级95，实践能力0级96。
杜邵阳综合评价：理论知识0级87，实践能力0级99。
杜邵阳和以前的苏恒一样，偏科有点明显，他动手能力很强但理论知识就差了那么一丢丢了，苏恒都觉得有些好笑，他在以前排名低，总是全系五十名开外，两个原因，1是高中时喜爱战斗型模式，哪怕成了灵木师种子，上辈子地球毫无灵力，这辈子重生后一接触就在少年时代，特喜欢战斗型的飞藤术、花神术，高中三年几乎一大半精力都在这上面，学习理论知识的时间自然就少了。
大一开始才紧追慢赶，回到灵木师正确的轨道上，另一个大原因是，你木神术修炼不起来，也没有光、火、冰、土之类天赋，明光术、变温术等根本无法修炼，这是天赋的缺陷。
有天赋的轻松修炼入门，有钱有势的可以购买对应的天赋灵植，但苏恒这两点一个都没有，才瘸腿的厉害。
杜邵阳这个同学让他觉得小奇葩，0级99分的实践能力，随时破入1级，足以见证他天赋如何，反倒是拼脑子，记忆力理解力的理论知识才80多？
就算理论知识也有很多门学科，但记忆力理解力，可不会被天赋分隔限制的。
苏恒只能感慨，杜邵阳估计和他高中时代一样，走了歪路，兴趣不在理论知识上，否则他未必输给于飞煌。
站在后台等待着赛场前台的一次次报幕，介绍，看着身边人越来越少，后续出场的同学，得到的掌声和欢呼也逐渐在减弱？
苏恒并没有紧张。
“两辈子加起来我也四十多岁了，千万不能在有了大优势后，现场发挥失误导致败北，那就太搞笑了。”
他的综合评价现在超越所有大一同学，连王会这个十岁开始修炼，还服用各式各样灵丹妙药提升天赋的家伙，都比不上他，差距很明显。
但他不敢有一丝大意。
台下刻苦努力，一上台因为紧张或其他因素演砸了的事，在世界上罕见么？太常见了！
高考发挥失常，考驾照临场失误，快签约的业务，签字前一个不当行为惹得客户不快风波皱起……
四十多岁的心理年龄，苏恒只用几个呼吸就平静了下来。
前台也响起了郭展鹏新的声音，“下面，有请我们灵木系大一名额赛最后一位选手登场，苏恒！”
话语下，苏恒平静起步。
content_en:
The academic masters participating in the competition for the only spot in the Spirit Wood Department freshman year are all elite.
Wang Hui's comprehensive evaluation: Theoretical knowledge level 1 is 09 points, and practical ability level 1 is 07 points. Even if this person graduates from college and enters the society now, he is still at the level of outstanding undergraduate graduates nationwide.
Yu Feihuang's comprehensive evaluation: theoretical knowledge level 0 is 99, and practical ability is level 0 and is 98.
Li Yalin's comprehensive evaluation: theoretical knowledge level 0 is 96, and practical ability is level 0 and is 97.
Su Heng's own comprehensive evaluation: theoretical knowledge level 1, 45, and practical ability, level 1, 19.
He was slightly surprised to find that except for Wang Huihe's data from a week ago, both the arrogant Yu Feihuang and the goddess Li Yalin had higher ratings than a week ago. However, this was normal. He was studying hard and completing tasks released by the God of Study system from time to time, and other top students would not wait idle.
Put aside this perennial top three academic.
There are two other people in the top five in various assessments in the entire department over the past year.
Guo Yaoguang's comprehensive evaluation: theoretical knowledge level 0 is 95, and practical ability is level 0 and is 96.
Du Shaoyang's comprehensive evaluation: theoretical knowledge level 0 is 87, and practical ability is level 0 and is 99.
Du Shaoyang, like Su Heng before, is a bit partial to science. He has strong practical skills but only a few theoretical knowledge. Su Heng even found it a bit funny. He was ranked low in the past, always outside the top 50 in the department, for two reasons. 1. He loved combat models in high school. Shiki, even if you become a spiritual wood master seed, the earth had no spiritual power in your previous life. After being reborn in this life, you have been exposed to it since you were a boy. You especially like the combat-type flying vines and flower magic. In the three years of high school, almost half of your energy was devoted to this, so there was naturally less time to learn theoretical knowledge.
At the beginning of your freshman year, you have been catching up and getting back on the right track as a spiritual wood master. Another big reason is that you cannot practice the wood magic, and you do not have talents such as light, fire, ice, and earth. You cannot practice the bright light skill, temperature change skill, etc. at all. This is a flaw in your talent.
Those who are talented can easily get started with cultivation, and those who are rich and powerful can purchase the corresponding gifted spiritual plants. However, Su Heng has neither of these two points, which is why he is so lame.
Du Shaoyang, a classmate, made him think he was a little weird. His practical ability of 99 points at level 0 could break into level 1 at any time, which was enough to prove how talented he was. Instead, he struggled with his brain, and his theoretical knowledge of memory and understanding was only over 80?
Even theoretical knowledge has many subjects, but memory and understanding are not limited by talent.
Su Heng could only lament that Du Shaoyang probably took the same wrong path as he did in high school and was not interested in theoretical knowledge, otherwise he might not have lost to Yu Feihuang.
Standing backstage, waiting for the announcements and introductions from the front of the stadium, watching the number of people around you getting smaller and smaller, and the applause and cheers received by the students who will appear later are gradually weakening?
Su Heng was not nervous.
"In my two lifetimes, I am already over 40 years old. After having a big advantage, I must not make mistakes on the spot and lead to defeat. That would be too funny."
His comprehensive evaluation now surpasses that of all his freshman classmates. Even Wang Hui, a guy who started practicing at the age of ten and took various miraculous pills to improve his talent, can't compare to him. The gap is obvious.
But he didn't dare to be careless.
Is it rare in the world for people to work hard off the stage and then fail due to nervousness or other factors once they get on stage? Too common!
I performed abnormally in the college entrance examination, made a mistake on the spot when taking the driver's license test, signed a business quickly, and made a customer unhappy due to improper behavior before signing, causing a storm...
With a mental age of over forty, Su Heng calmed down in just a few breaths.
Guo Zhanpengxin's voice also sounded at the front desk, "Now, let's invite the last contestant of our spiritual tree department's freshman qualifying competition, Su Heng!"
Under the words, Su Heng started calmly.
